verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair thing to ask of an inference API provider, so the axis applies. The evidence shows cURL, Python and TypeScript examples, OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs, a console, and instructions for connecting third-party agents such as Claude Code and Codex, but no first-party Munito CLI. Third-party CLIs and raw HTTP access are adjacent or user-side workarounds and earn no credit for this story.
